parameter-group.name: transformations
parameter-group.label: Transform Values
parameter-group.description: These configuration parameters alter a received value before it is assigned to an item.

parameter.name: stateTopic
parameter.label: MQTT State Topic
parameter.description: An MQTT topic that this channel subscribes to for Contact state updates.

parameter.name: transformationPattern
parameter.label: Incoming Value Transformations
parameter.description: Applies transformations to an incoming MQTT topic value.

parameter.name: nullValue
parameter.label: NULL Value
parameter.description: If the received MQTT value matches this, treat it as NULL.

parameter.name: ignoreValue
parameter.label: Ignore Value
parameter.description: If the received MQTT value matches this, ignore the update.

parameter.name: on
parameter.label: Custom Open Value
parameter.description: An additional value that is recognized as OPEN.

parameter.name: off
parameter.label: Custom Closed Value
parameter.description: An additional value that is recognized as CLOSED.
